User.title: User
User.description: User profile containing identity and role information (student, teacher, or admin)

uid.description: Unique user identifier matching Firebase Auth UID

displayName.description: Display name of the student or teacher

role.description: Access control role: student, teacher, or admin

schoolClass.description: Class grade or section (e.g., Kelas 6 SD Pesisir)

FoodLog.title: FoodLog
FoodLog.description: Detailed private student food log entry containing nutritional amounts and reflection

imageUrl.description: URL or base64 preview of the food label image

NutritionLog.title: NutritionLog
NutritionLog.description: Aggregated structured nutrition log entry for teacher monitoring and class trend dashboards

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp string of when Step 4 reflection completed

food_item.description: Name of the packaged snack or food

akg_percentage.description: Percentage of AKG contained in the food

deficiency_percentage.description: Calculated nutrient deficit percentage against 30% AKG ideal

chosen_local_solution.description: Chosen coastal food solution (e.g. Ikan Kembung, Daun Kelor)

balanced_status.description: True if the student selected a healthy solution to balance the meal

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles storing RBAC role (student vs teacher/admin)

/nutrition_logs/{logId}.description: Aggregated class nutrition logs accessible by teachers and admins for trend analysis
